cloud-service.criteria.free.en: Log in with any Cardinal account to enable this.

cloud-service.criteria.subscribed.en: Log in with a subscribed Cardinal account to enable this.

pdp.desc.en: Allow this media server to join the Popularity Data Pool and contribute anonymous play counts. Your media apps will also use the pool's data with your own media to display trends.

pdp.confirm-disable.desc.en: Leaving the Popularity Data Pool will disable trend data in your Music and Cinema apps.

ra.desc.en: Enable remote access for this media server to reach your self-hosted apps from anywhere.

ra.request-access.desc-p1.en: Remote Access is currently a beta feature that is available to a limited number of users. Once enabled, you will remain in a queue until there is room for your media server. There is a maximum of one (1) media server per user during the beta.

ra.request-access.desc-p2.en: Inactive servers may be pruned from the beta. If that happens to you, feel free to queue up again.

ra.confirm-disable.desc.en: This media server will stop being reachable from outside your network, and its remote URLs will stop working.
